Television is where ideological messaging works hardest, because a series gets 10 to 60 hours of your attention instead of two. A show can play its politics slowly, one episode at a time, until the frame feels normal. That is exactly why we score full seasons the same way we score films: every trope, every arc, every insertion, weighted and summed.

VirtueVigil has now scored 60 television seasons. This list ranks the top 25 from most traditional to least. The top of the table is a rebuke to the idea that quality demands progressive politics: Band of Brothers, Chernobyl, and The Bear all sit comfortably in STRONGLY TRADITIONAL territory while being some of the most acclaimed television ever made. Every entry links to the full scored review.

  1. 1

    The Bear (Season 2) (2023)

    STRONGLY TRADITIONAL +31 TRAD

    The Bear Season 2 is the story of what happens when people who have been surviving decide to build something instead. That turns out to be a more traditional story than Season 1, and a richer one.

  2. 2

    Band of Brothers (2001)

    STRONGLY TRADITIONAL +29 TRAD

    Band of Brothers stands as the gold standard of military television, a ten-part masterwork that honors the men of Easy Company without descending into jingoism or the cynical deconstruction that defines modern war storytelling.

  3. 3

    Chernobyl (2019) (2019)

    STRONGLY TRADITIONAL +26 TRAD

    Chernobyl is the best thing HBO has ever produced and one of the most morally coherent works of television in the medium's history.

  4. 4

    The Terminal List (2022)

    STRONGLY TRADITIONAL +24 TRAD

    The Terminal List has a 40% on Rotten Tomatoes from critics and a 94% audience score. That gap tells you everything you need to know about where the show sits culturally. The premise is tight. Commander James Reece leads a SEAL platoon into an ambush in Syria.

  5. 5

    Cobra Kai (2018)

    STRONGLY TRADITIONAL +23 TRAD

    Cobra Kai is the most unexpectedly traditional piece of entertainment American television produced in the 2020s. That is not a qualified statement. It is a simple observation that requires no asterisk and no apology.

  6. 6

    Stranger Things (Season 1) (2016)

    STRONGLY TRADITIONAL +21 TRAD

    Stranger Things Season 1 is the rare cultural phenomenon that earns every ounce of its acclaim.

  7. 7

    Shogun (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +19 TRAD

    Shogun is the best television event of 2024 and one of the finest historical dramas ever made. That is not hyperbole.

  8. 8

    Reacher - Season 3 (2025)

    TRADITIONAL +19 TRAD

    Reacher Season 3 does something the third season of almost any television series struggles to do: it deepens without diluting. The premise is unchanged. Jack Reacher wanders into a problem, identifies who is responsible, and makes them regret it.

  9. 9

    Game of Thrones (Season 1) (2011)

    TRADITIONAL +19 TRAD

    Game of Thrones Season 1 is one of the most culturally significant television seasons of the twenty-first century, and it is also one of the most traditionally moral.

  10. 10

    Yellowstone: Season 1 (2018)

    TRADITIONAL +19 TRAD

    Yellowstone Season 1 is the foundation of what would become the most culturally significant conservative drama of the 21st century.

  11. 11

    The Bear (Season 1) (2022)

    TRADITIONAL +18 TRAD

    The Bear is about what it costs to be good at something and what it takes to build something that lasts.

  12. 12

    The Bear (Season 3) (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +18 TRAD

    The Bear Season 3 is the season where the show stops trying to be loved and commits to being honest. That honesty is uncomfortable, often frustrating, and at times genuinely difficult to watch.

  13. 13

    Little House on the Prairie (2026) (2026)

    TRADITIONAL +18 TRAD

    Netflix has done something genuinely surprising with Little House on the Prairie (2026): they made a period drama about pioneer life that respects its source material.

  14. 14

    Daredevil: Born Again (2025)

    TRADITIONAL +17 TRAD

    Daredevil: Born Again arrives with a question hanging over it: can Disney make something as raw as what Netflix made? The answer, after a creative overhaul that scrapped the original legal-procedural vision in favor of a proper continuation, is a qualified yes.

  15. 15

    The Pitt (2025)

    TRADITIONAL +17 TRAD

    The Pitt is the best network-style medical procedural in years, possibly since ER was at its height. It is not accidental that Noah Wyle, who spent years on ER, is the lead. Creator R. Scott Gemmill also came up through that show's writer's room.

  16. 16

    Tulsa King - Season 2 (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +17 TRAD

    The question Tulsa King Season 2 has to answer is the same question every successful second season faces: did you have more story, or did you just have more episodes? The answer here is yes and yes, which is the good answer.

  17. 17

    Tulsa King (2022)

    TRADITIONAL +16 TRAD

    Sylvester Stallone is 77 years old and he is having the best run of his career. Tulsa King is not a great show in the prestige television sense.

  18. 18

    The Night Agent: Season 3 (2026)

    TRADITIONAL +16 TRAD

    Not a woke trap. The Night Agent is one of Netflix's most reliable action properties precisely because it delivers exactly what it promises: a good-looking guy with a badge chasing bad guys through exotic locations. Season 3 doesn't ambush you with ideology.

  19. 19

    Landman - Season 2 (2025)

    TRADITIONAL +16 TRAD

    Landman Season 2 picks up where the first season left it: Tommy Norris is still the man between the world that produces energy and the world that consumes it without acknowledging what that production costs.

  20. 20

    Widow's Bay (2026)

    TRADITIONAL +16 TRAD

    Apple TV+'s Widow's Bay is the best new show of 2026. It is also, against all expectations for a series about a demonic covenant maintained by a small-town government, surprisingly traditional.

  21. 21

    Landman (2024)

    TRADITIONAL +15 TRAD

    Taylor Sheridan has built an empire making television for the people coastal media forgot. Landman is that empire's newest flagship, and it's the most specifically industrial show he's ever made.

  22. 22

    Scrubs - Season 10 Revival (2026)

    TRADITIONAL +13 TRAD

  23. 23

    King of the Hill: Season 15 (2026)

    TRADITIONAL +13 TRAD

    Mike Judge and Greg Daniels have done something remarkable with King of the Hill: Season 15: they brought back a beloved animated sitcom after more than a decade and made it feel like it never left.

  24. 24

    Is Pluribus Woke? | VirtueVigil Review (2025)

    TRADITIONAL +12 TRAD

    Pluribus is the rarest thing in modern prestige television - a show that genuinely refuses to tell you what to think.

  25. 25

    The Sopranos: Season 1 (1999)

    TRADITIONAL +12 TRAD

    The Sopranos: Season 1 is a masterwork of American television and one of the least ideologically captured prestige dramas ever produced.

Every score above comes from the same deterministic methodology: severity, authenticity, and centrality, weighted and summed per trope. Browse all reviews at the full VirtueVigil database.
